guitar.evidence: Ritchie Blackmore's scalloped-fretboard Fender Stratocaster is extremely well documented and central to Rainbow's sound on tracks like 'Kill the King' and 'Long Live Rock N Roll'.

tone.target: fast bright Marshall/Plexi crunch with bite and light fuzz
tone.profile: fast bright Marshall/Plexi crunch with bite and light fuzz
tone.summary: A high-gain, bright Plexi-style chain utilizing a slight Fuzz boost for bite, followed by the UK 45 amp and UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve aggressive, punchy classic rock tones.
corrections: drop reverb as a core element
make fuzz more obvious than overdrive
